topics.title: Symmetry
topics.concept:
Have you ever folded a paper heart or looked closely at a butterfly's wings? If you can fold a shape perfectly in half so that both sides match exactly, that shape is symmetrical. Symmetry is all about balance, matching, and mirror images!

  • What is a Line of Symmetry? A line of symmetry is an imaginary straight "fold line" that cuts a shape exactly in half. If you place a mirror right along this line, the reflection looks exactly like the other half of the shape.

examples.problem: Look at the standard Rectangle shown below. How many different lines of symmetry can you find? ``ascii ┌───────────────┐ │ │ └───────────────┘ ``
examples.solution:
1. Try folding the rectangle vertically (up-and-down) down the middle. The left half matches the right half perfectly. That is 1 vertical line.
  2. Try folding it horizontally (sideways) across the middle. The top half matches the bottom half perfectly. That is 1 horizontal line.
  3. Try folding it diagonally from corner to corner. In a rectangle, the corners do not line up perfectly when folded diagonally (try this with a piece of paper!). So, diagonal folds are not lines of symmetry.
  4. Add up the correct lines: 1 + 1 = 2.
Answer: 2 lines of symmetry

recap: Symmetry means an object looks exactly the same on both sides of a separating fold line.
The fold line that divides a symmetrical shape into perfect mirror images is called the line of symmetry.
Shapes can have vertical, horizontal, multiple, or zero lines of symmetry.
Objects that do not have matching halves are called asymmetrical.
When completing a half-drawing, every point on the reflection must be the exact same distance from the symmetry line as the original drawing.

questions.q: Which letter has a vertical line of symmetry?
How many lines of symmetry does a circle have?
questions.explanation: Circle has infinite lines of symmetry

questions.q: Which shape has exactly 4 lines of symmetry?
Shape looking same on both sides of a line is?
How many lines of symmetry does equilateral triangle have?
questions.explanation: Equilateral triangle has 3 lines of symmetry

questions.q: Rectangle has how many lines of symmetry?
Which letter has NO line of symmetry?
questions.explanation: Z has no line of symmetry

questions.q: Fold along symmetry line. What happens?
A butterfly has which type of symmetry?
Regular pentagon has how many lines of symmetry?
questions.explanation: Regular pentagon has 5 lines of symmetry

questions.q: Shape with 6 sides and 6 lines of symmetry?
Letter H has which type of symmetry?
Which shape has rotational symmetry of order 4?
questions.explanation: Square looks same 4 times in full rotation

questions.q: Shape with exactly 1 line of symmetry?
questions.explanation: Isosceles triangle has 1 line of symmetry

questions.q: Left half of symmetrical shape shows 4 squares. Full shape has?
Regular hexagon has how many lines of symmetry?
questions.explanation: Regular hexagon has 6 lines of symmetry
